sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
- Players with the "Edge of Darkness" or "The Unheard" game editions will start with this container.
- Can only fit:
  - Document case
  - Dogtag case
  - Gingy keychain
  - Injector case
  - Key tool
  - Keycard holder case
  - S I C C organizational pouch
  - Simple wallet
  - WZ Wallet
  - Loot
  - Provisions
  - Meds
  - Keys, Keycards & Maps
  - Weapon mods (Besides magazines, special scopes and some mounts)
  - Armor plates
  - Currency
  - Armbands
  - Earpieces
  - Vanity Face cover
  - Vanity Headwear
  - Vanity Eyewear
  - Melee weapons
  - Special equipment (Besides repair kits)

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: Easter eggs and References: The Secure container Gamma is modeled after the real life pistol case called the SE Series™ Scoped Pistol Case. The only differences between the real life counterpart and the in-game model is coloration.
